subject: Current-head review 633c75b: Alpha2 hotfix carries major fixes but terminal/presentation contracts remain incomplete
body: GitHub main advanced to 633c75be26001d5a4ef6e04c7696e8246713be44 and Gen6 Alpha2 Hotfix CI run 37040797908 is in progress. Manager revalidated the hotfix patcher itself. Coarse-public shadow-only authority and passive canonical wallpaper converge with reviewed contracts. However the terminal fence is still incomplete: guards exist before prepare/reassert, but there is no second native-cover topology recheck after the blocking physical wake and before logical route activation, and the app async completion/retry path still lacks equivalent active-close-cycle/legal-state fencing. Early logical-inner wake is experimental: it checks geometry/physical identity but is not bound to an immutable opening attempt/cancellation token and forces STATE_ON without a FIRST_USEFUL receipt. The hotfix also does not implement the newly corroborated presentation-release safety invariant (bridge can still end on cover owner loss; Gen6 V2 still clears early latch at OPEN_INNER) or the full Transition Lab production-authority identity propagation. Actual 120Hz remains unproven. CI may continue, but even green = CI_PASS only; do not call this beta-ready or PHYSICAL_FOLD7_PASS until these deltas and device gates are resolved.
